question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 5**
solution:
The correct answer is "**exciting**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **certain: **able to be firmly relied on to happen or be the case.
 
• **boring: **not interesting; tedious.
 
• **exciting: **causing great enthusiasm and eagerness.
 
• **popular: **liked or admired by many people or by a particular person or group.
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, **"exciting" **is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
 
• The speaker is describing her life after leaving the habit of watching TV.
 
• There was a positive change in the speaker's life and therefore she described her life as **exciting**.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.**

**The complete passage is: **I decided to stay away from television ***(1) for*** a whole year. After a week, I started feeling ***(2) depressed*__.** But, my friend Bess cheered me up. She*** (3) encouraged* **me every day and would take me places. It was *(4) unbelievable *how much fun we had without TV. My life had become more ***(5) exciting*** without the good old idiot box.
